messages:
Priya (sec): Alert from observability: keystore unwrap errors in eu-west-1 after RBAC rollout. Seeing KMS AccessDenied.
Maya (eng-infra): paste a sample log line and principal?
Ravi (oncall): log:
```
2026-03-25T07:11:12Z proxy-47 ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:333333:key/a1b2c3
principal=arn:aws:sts::333333:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/session-9 req=rid-9f8e
```
Maya (eng-infra): looks like PR 4477 tightened iam:AssumeRole and removed the delegated principal. Quick mitigation: add a time-limited key policy grant for that assumed-role arn and restart pods. Also bump CERT_CACHE_TTL to reduce user impact.
Omar (sre): agree. I'll push a helm patch to set CERT_CACHE_TTL=600 and soft-fail to cached certs for 10m.
kms-bot: Emergency key-policy override applied for 1h. Audit entry created.
deploy-bot: rollout proxy-eu v4.1.0 -> v4.1.1 started; updated 5/5.
Ravi (oncall): after override+restart, decrypt success rate normal. 502 rate back to baseline.
Priya (sec): requirements for compliance: 1) log incident_id=inc-20260325-eu-kms on all related logs; 2) capture assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id in cert-fetch logs; 3) make temp grant via terraform with explicit expiry; 4) alert keystore.decrypt_fail >5%/5m.
Maya (eng-infra): I'll open RFC to reintroduce scoped delegation or update key policy permanently with kms:ViaService + region condition. Will include IAM diffs and audit samples.
Omar (sre): scheduling postmortem and will collect IAM policy history + keystore metrics.
Priya (sec): thanks team, keep incident channel updated and assign INC-6360 for RCA.
